summary: Resolve report ownership before generation and enforce organization report homes

delivery.outcome: Publish a standard-owned report placement preflight and conformance checks: repository-owned reports stay with their owner, organization reports belong to org/report, final reports cannot remain only in temporary storage.
nonGoals: No automatic repository creation, publication grants or wholesale migration of historical reports.
No claim of organization-wide enforcement without consumer receipts.

architecture.decision: Extend wellmanifest/docs rather than create a competing standard. Add explicit delivery scope, generic org/report resolution, read-only fail-closed preflight and backward-compatible historical document inspection.
interfaceChanges: Optional scope metadata and preflight CLI
architecture.rollback: Consumers retain their previous immutable standard pin; previous report history remains available in Git.

validation.evidence: 37 unit tests pass. Exact-head governance follows the material commit; historical ticket-003 terminal state restored from authenticated GitHub merge and verified Git ancestry.
